args.title: Fix error message for column mismatch in en.json
args.body: The current error message in src/i18n/en.json reads: "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header". This is misleading as users may still upload files that conform to the expected format. The revision aims to clarify the message to better assist users in identifying potential mismatches in their uploads.
